why_it_moved.text: Reformulation Rate rose 4.80%, and Queries per User rose 2.30%. Together with the 0.72% drop in the primary, that fits users searching again because first results were worse.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: The drop is steady from the first days after exposure to the last, so it is not a novelty effect.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Part of the extra queries may come from a few struggling users or one query class such as tail queries; no cut has been run yet.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate before exposure would make this a broken test.
Cuts showing the drop sits in one fixable query class would justify a rerun of a revised ranker.
